title: Forrest Gump — Life story

hook.quote: My mama always said, life was like a box of chocolates. You never know what you're gonna get.
hook.context: Forrest avtobus bekatidagi o'rindiqda o'tirib, yonidagi notanish ayolga konfet taklif qiladi va onasining gapini eslaydi. Diqqat qiling: "life IS like" emas, "life WAS like" — chunki "said"dan keyin zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi. Ko'pchilik bu iqtibosni "is" bilan noto'g'ri keltiradi.

reading: Forrest Gump sits on a bench at a bus stop in Savannah, Georgia, and tells his life story to strangers. He is not a clever man, but he is honest and kind.

When Forrest was a child, he lived with his mother in Greenbow, Alabama. He had weak legs, so he had to wear metal braces. Other children used to laugh at him. Only one girl, Jenny, became his friend.
One day some boys chased him, and Jenny shouted, "Run, Forrest, run!" Forrest started to run, the braces broke, and he discovered that he could run very fast.

His mother always believed in him. She used to tell him that he was no different from anybody else. She also gave him simple advice for difficult moments: life was like a box of chocolates, and you never knew what you were going to get.
Thanks to his speed, Forrest went to college and played football. Later he joined the army and went to Vietnam. There he met his best friend, Bubba, who dreamed of starting a shrimp business.
Bubba died in the war, but Forrest kept his promise. He bought a boat, and after a long period of bad luck, the company became very successful. He shared the profit with Bubba's family.
Forrest never planned to become rich or famous. He simply did what was in front of him, and he did it with all his heart.

grammar.title: Past Simple, used to va "said ... was"
explain: **Past Simple** — o'tmishda tugagan voqealar, ketma-ket: Forrest **started** to run, the braces **broke**, he **discovered**... Hikoya qilishning asosiy zamoni.
Noto'g'ri fe'llarni yodlang: break → **broke**, go → **went**, buy → **bought**, meet → **met**.
**used to + fe'l** — o'tmishdagi takrorlanuvchi odat, hozir yo'q: Other children **used to laugh** at him. Bitta voqea uchun emas: "Jenny used to shout once" — xato.

**said + ... was**: "Mama always **said** life **was** like a box of chocolates." Gapni boshqa birov aytganini yetkazganda zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi (is → was, know → knew). Shuning uchun filmda "was".

exercises.q: When Forrest ___ a child, he lived in Alabama.

exercises.why: Takrorlanuvchi o'tmish odati: used to + fe'l.

exercises.q: The braces ___ and he ran very fast.
exercises.why: break — noto'g'ri fe'l: break → broke → broken.

exercises.q: Forrest ___ to Vietnam with the army.
Mama always said life ___ like a box of chocolates.
exercises.why: said dan keyin zamon orqaga suriladi: is → was.
Did bilan fe'l asosiy shaklda: did + plan.

exercises.q: He ___ a boat and started the business.
I ___ play football when I was a kid, but now I don't.
